items.title: File Einspruch against the 2026 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats beim Finanzamt Musterjena eingehen; die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag nach der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted Mon 16.08.2027. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 by a tax office, so delivery (Bekanntgabe) is deemed to occur on the 4th day after posting: 16.08 (+1)=17, (+2)=18, (+3)=19, (+4)=20 → Fri 20.08.2027. For Finanzamt letters, if that 4th day falls on a weekend/holiday it moves to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO); 20.08.2027 is a Friday and not a holiday in Thüringen, so delivery stands at 20.08.2027. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO then runs from the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 20.09.2027 (Monday) → not a weekend/holiday, so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
